regression_diagnostics.bootstrap_units: entire trajectories, with replacement; 600 draws per fit
regression_diagnostics.evaluation: first ten documented test trajectories, fixed during bootstrap; conditional on those ten states
regression_diagnostics.intervals: percentile intervals from 200 bootstrap fits; Monte Carlo quantile precision limited

stress_rollout_summary.selection_source: exploratory 12-case small-step extension after no moderate-amplitude activation in the original sweep
stress_rollout_summary.selection: minimum stated priority among finite activating cases with amplitude <=.3
